summary.name: Tavus
summary.one_liner: Tavus is a platform for building real-time, face-to-face AI agents ("PALs") that see, hear, respond and look like people, offered via API, a no-code PAL Maker, or managed enterprise solutions.
use_cases: Build an AI sales development rep on a website
Run AI sales role-play practice calls
Create a clinical or educational AI consultant
Present slides live with an AI avatar
Join Zoom, Google Meet or Teams calls as an AI participant
Deploy a branded conversational video interface for marketing
summary.what_it_does: Tavus provides PALs (Personified Application Layers), real-time AI agents with a face, voice and personality that can converse face-to-face. Per the page, a PAL can present slides, share its screen, create visuals on the fly, browse websites, and join Zoom, Google Meet or Teams calls. It can use built-in LLMs or a bring-your-own model, has a knowledge base, and remembers past conversations. Developers can build PALs through APIs, non-technical users can make one with the PAL Maker, and enterprises can commission fully managed deployments. The page also previews Griffin, described as a video-to-video human interaction model.
notable: PALs: real-time AI agents with face, voice and personality that see and hear via video
No-code PAL Maker to create and launch an agent in minutes
Griffin (preview): video-to-video model that listens while it talks
Customer examples cited on page: Salesforce's Piper SDR, Orum's Aurora coach, Med Learning Group's Ruby CME consultant
caveats: Griffin is labeled as a preview
Enterprise Solutions are bespoke and fully managed, so custom pricing applies
Performance figures on the page (e.g., 6x meetings) are customer-reported marketing claims
